gui.guerra_ezuberante.how_to_test: In creative, summon Renan and Arthur with their eggs in the Guerra Ezuberante tab. They stay peaceful. Attacking them in Survival or Adventure triggers retaliation. Right-click for voice lines; K opens this panel.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.renan_details: Faction: Direita Missão. Health: 30 HP. Damage: 4. Status: basic combat implemented. Classic 64 × 64 skin supplied by the author.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.arthur_details: Faction: Direita Missão. Health: 32 HP. Damage: 5. Status: basic combat implemented. Author skin; scale 0.88, with matching hitbox and eyes.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.renan_combat: Renan only pursues his attacker. Combat entry starts the phonk without restarting on each hit. Invalid, distant or stalled targets are abandoned after up to 10 s without progress.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.arthur_combat: Arthur only retaliates after aggression. Combat entry plays the full É vagabundo sim recording, with an 11-second cooldown and no restart on repeated hits. Seven voice recordings remain available on right-click. Special powers are not implemented.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.character_descript: Renan and Arthur walk and watch players. They only attack in retaliation against a valid aggressor.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.future_characters: Other characters and troops remain planned. Scroll to see the selected character preview inside a world.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.abilities_notice: Renan and Arthur have basic combat. The special powers below remain planned; playing Me Respeita does not trigger the spinning attack.
gui.guerra_ezuberante.basic_combat_imple: Renan and Arthur: melee attacks and retaliation implemented. Special powers: not implemented.
